list: the official 55 trophies — names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them; guides written for this page

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Work the roadmap stages in order and use this tracker to see exactly which trophies remain — the counter in the header only reaches 55/55 when this one pops.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. It cannot be missed: start a new game, play the prologue through to its end, and the trophy pops as the mission completes. If you are replaying, any chapter select run of Gone Fishing also counts.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1, from Gone Fishing to the chapter finale. Unmissable and automatic — just keep following the story markers. Your chapter progress is visible on the pause screen if you want to check how much of the chapter is left.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full. Still unmissable: every chapter trophy in this list is awarded for simply finishing the chapter, on any difficulty. Keep a manual save at the chapter break — later chapters hold this run's missable trophies, and a clean save here is cheap insurance.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The city opens up further during this chapter, which is a good moment to start the collectible and activity grinds in Stage 3 alongside the story — but nothing here is missable, and every side activity stays available after the finale.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame sequence. Before starting the final mission, sweep the flagged missable trophies in this guide — several are tied to story moments and choices that a finished campaign cannot revisit without a replay.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the campaign's final mission. Make a manual save before you start it: the choices made during the finale feed Actions Speak Louder, and a pre-finale save lets you revisit the ending without replaying the whole game. The trophy pops as the credits sequence begins.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run, an early Chapter 1 job. Follow the mission markers, finish the run, and it unlocks at the mission-complete screen. Like every named-mission trophy in this list, it is awarded on completion on any difficulty and cannot be missed.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Stock up on armour and snacks before the finale shootout, and keep one manual save from before the heist starts — it is the run's first big set piece, and a save here is the community's recommended safety net for the missable moment trophies later on.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A quieter, character-led mission — no fail state to fear beyond the mission's own checkpoints. It unlocks automatically at completion; if you are chasing 100%, note the mission also introduces contacts whose strands appear in Stage 2 of the roadmap.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Bring a fast car and a full special-ability meter for the escape stretch, and the mission is straightforward. Awarded on completion, unmissable, and part of the Chapter 3 run toward Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown at the airport. Pay attention during this mission: Catch Me If You Can, one of the six missable trophies, is earned by making an unscheduled departure at VCIA inside this mission's window — check that guide before you start, and keep a save from the mission's opening.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, the campaign's big late set piece. Go in with full armour, a stocked weapon wheel and both protagonists' garages upgraded if you can — the final waves are the story's toughest gunfight. Unmissable on completion.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold, and the spine of the whole hunt: reach 100% on the game's completion counter. The counter is fed by the story, the character and stranger strands, and most of the activity and collectible trophies in Stage 3 — use the in-game completion checklist alongside this tracker, and treat every silver in this guide as a down payment on this gold. Nothing that feeds the counter is missable, so it can always be finished in free roam after the finale.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunt jumps and stunt sequences across Leonida. Stunt spots are repeatable, so the fastest route is a circuit: pick a fast bike or sports car, chain the ramp-dense districts of Vice Beach and the port, and let the on-screen stunt counter tick up. The game tracks the total for you — check it in the stats menu, and farm the same reliable ramps if you are short at the end.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity types at least once: races, drone races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, stunts, meditation, hunting and challenges are the nine the game counts. Most unlock as the story opens the map; starting one is enough — you do not need to win or finish it for it to register a try.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges — with Cunning Stunts, this is the grind the roadmap warns about. Learn each range's target pattern first with a silver run, then chase gold with the weapon class the challenge favours; accuracy bonuses beat raw speed on the moving-target sets. Challenges can be retried instantly, and your best medal per challenge is kept, so chip away at them in batches.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Winning — not just entering — is required, so learn each course's gate line on a practice run, then fly it clean: smooth lines through the gates beat full-throttle corrections. Locations appear on the map as you explore, and each win is recorded permanently.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not stack. Bring a tuned car in the right class for each event, and work through the map's race markers district by district. The shorter street races are the fastest wins; save the long point-to-points for when your garage is upgraded.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in one of his fishing challenges. Accept a challenge from Cal at the fishing spots, then win on total catch weight: use the best rod and bait you have unlocked, and fish the marked hotspots rather than open water. Losing costs nothing — challenge him again straight away until you win.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game at an arcade cabinet in Vice City. You must complete the game, not just start it — pick the shortest cabinet game on offer, play it to its end screen, and the trophy pops. Cabinets sit in arcades and bars around Ocean Beach.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's whole mission strand, through to his final mission. Andy's jobs appear as letter markers once the story introduces him; strands can be completed in any order and stay available after the finale, so this cannot be missed — just do not leave the strand half-done and forget it, because only the final mission pays the trophy.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand through its final mission. His jobs lean on the water — keep a fast boat stored at a marina before the last job so you are not scrambling when it starts. The strand stays open after the story ends, and the trophy lands on the final mission's completion screen.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand, ending with his final mission. Billy's jobs are road-heavy — a durable bike or muscle car makes the last run far easier. As with the other character strands, it is completable at any point after it unlocks, including post-story free roam.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full Strangers & Freaks strands anywhere in Leonida. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish strands rather than starting many: the question-mark markers on the map show strand starts, and your phone's contacts list shows which strands are mid-way. Eight is fewer than the game offers, so pick the strands nearest your usual routes.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's strand through to his final mission. His supply-run jobs reward a helicopter or fast plane if you have one unlocked — the last delivery is timed generously but not kindly. Available after the story; the trophy pops at the final mission's end.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand and its final mission. Keep a manual save before his last job if you are also chasing the choice-driven Actions Speak Louder counter — his finale involves a decision the game remembers. The strand itself cannot be missed and remains open in free roam.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots sit at scenic overlooks — rooftops, piers, hilltops and beach ends — and each visit is permanent once the meditation completes. Sweep them region by region while exploring for The Goodtime State so the two grinds share the same travelling.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting job and bring down the unique animal he sends you after. Track it from the marked search area at dawn or dusk when animals are active, and use a scoped rifle — a clean kill from range ends the hunt fastest. The job appears once Bret's strand unlocks and stays available until done.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida in shops, rooftops and interiors; a set only counts when every card in it is found, so finish sets one at a time instead of scattering pickups. The collection menu shows each set's missing cards — sweep the three shortest sets first for the fastest silver in the game.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK photo spots at 100 different locations. Each marked spot asks for a photo of a specific view or landmark; the in-game counter tracks your total toward 100. Work district by district with the map filtered to photo spots, and pair the sweep with the exploration trophy — most districts hold several spots within a short drive of each other.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's Challenges — the short scored tasks scattered through the world and menus. Challenges overlap heavily with the other grinds: stunt, race, shooting and collection feats all count, so check the challenges list late in Stage 3 and you will likely find most of the 50 already done. Top up with the quick driving and on-foot challenges.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While playing with your partner beside you, earn a four-star wanted level and then lose it completely — the stars must fully clear while your partner is with you, not after switching away. Fastest method: cause mayhem together in a fast car until four stars, then break line of sight in the drainage canals or the port container yards and wait out the search in a side street.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level ever fully dropping between them. Plan a tight triangle of shops in one district, keep your weapon drawn in each, and move fast — the chain breaks if the stars clear, so do not hide between robberies. A fast four-door car parked outside each shop keeps the run smooth.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a vehicle counts when you first enter or register it. Rich districts spawn the rare end of the list: cruise the Ocean Beach valet rows, marina car parks and airport lots, and get in everything you have not driven. The vehicle section of the stats menu shows your discovered count as you go.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies inside one Combat Focus activation. Set it up where enemies cluster: a gang operation or a police standoff with a full ability meter. Trigger Focus, then sweep targets with headshots before the meter drains — a shotgun or automatic rifle makes the five far easier than a pistol. Story shootouts like Operation Savage Glory also offer dense enough waves.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. During the VCIA Takedown story mission, leave the airport in a way the mission does not schedule: take an aircraft from the VCIA apron and get airborne instead of following the mission's own exit. The window closes when the mission ends, and a finished campaign cannot reopen it — keep a manual save before VCIA Takedown (see Hi-Jacked) so a missed departure is a reload, not a replay. Sources disagree on whether a post-story airport visit counts, so earn it inside the mission to be safe.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Survive an encounter with a Rhino tank. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and around military-guarded sites; the trophy is for dealing with the encounter — draw the tank's fire, break its line of sight with heavy cover, and either destroy it with explosives or escape its patrol area on foot through buildings it cannot follow into. Sticky explosives on the rear armour end it fastest.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store with zero detection: no alarms, no witnesses, no wanted level at any point. Go at night with a suppressed weapon and a mask, clear the store quietly, and leave through the back. If a detection icon fills, abandon the run and retry — a detected robbery still pays cash but not this trophy.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time — the escape is part of the count, so a bust inside the vault wastes the run. Bring cutting gear and a getaway car staged a block away, clear the vault, and lose the heat through the canals before the roadblocks set. Vaults restock over in-game days, so rotate between banks across the state.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hold up an armored truck and get away clean. Trucks run fixed cash routes between banks; ambush one on a quiet stretch, blow the rear doors with explosives, grab the cash and break line of sight before the escort response lands. One successful robbery and escape is all the trophy asks.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal all 52 areas of Leonida on the map. An area counts when you first enter it, so this is a travelling trophy: drive or fly every district, island and backwater until the map has no fog left. Pair it with the meditation spots and WAiNK locations — between them they route you through nearly every area on the list.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation run by each of the nine gangs. Operations are marked in gang territory once discovered; keep a note of which gangs you have hit, because the game does not list them — this tracker's notes are your friend. One robbery per gang is enough, and operations respawn, so a cleared site can be revisited for a gang you still owe.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach — the rooftop and terrace bars along the strip serve them. Walk in, order the cocktail at the bar, and let the drinking animation play out fully; the trophy pops as you finish. Any time of day works, though sunset is the view the trophy is named for.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass front — in classic style means through the window, not the door. The cleanest chance comes during the story sequence that puts you inside a showroom with a car to hand; in free roam some showrooms lock their display cars. Keep a manual save before any story visit to a showroom, and if the moment passes, reload rather than hoping a later showroom cooperates.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and land the follow-through the alley's mini-game asks for — a clean, full-swing delivery. Enter the alley, start a game at the counter, and complete your throws; the trophy registers when the follow-through shot is made. It can be retried freely, so experiment with the swing timing until it lands.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. This hidden trophy tracks a story partnership moment 'with mass appeal' — a public, crowd-facing scene with your partner that only happens once in the campaign. Because the official description is deliberately vague and the moment is choice-adjacent, keep a manual save at each chapter break in the late story, and if a public partner scene plays out, let it finish without skipping. If your run ends without it, the chapter saves are the fastest way back.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: MISSABLE-leaning. PlayStation tracks this hidden counter to 500 — the game's running tally of decisions, big and small, that you make across the whole run: dialogue picks, mission approaches, and partner choices all feed it. A normal full playthrough that engages with side content clears 500 comfortably, but a speed-run that skips optional conversations can end short — so talk to people, take the optional calls, and check the counter in the stats menu before starting the final mission; if you are short, free-roam choices still count until the credits.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. A hidden one-try trophy: fail at something the story gives you a second attempt at, then succeed on that second try. The description gives nothing else away, so the safe play is the chapter-break saves — when a story attempt fails and the game offers an immediate retry, take the retry and succeed, rather than reloading a save to erase the failure. If your whole run passes without a natural fail-and-retry, the saves let you engineer one in a replayed mission.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. The game's strange-event trophy: witness one of Leonida's scripted oddities — the kind of thing the description refuses to explain. These events are tied to specific places at specific hours, most reported around the swamps and the coast at night. Because the trigger window is narrow, treat any 'what just happened' moment as precious: stay and watch it play out fully instead of driving on. The sources list the known event spots; visit them on your Stage 3 sweeps so a miss costs minutes, not a replay.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by: from a moving car or bike, use the melee attack as you pass so your swing — not the vehicle — makes contact. A slow pass along a crowded Ocean Beach sidewalk on a bike is the reliable setup; the hit must come from the melee weapon, so feather the speed and swing early.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — vaults, trucks and operations — and are handed over through the contacts the story gives you. Bank the bills after every robbery instead of sitting on them, and the total builds steadily through Stage 4; the stats menu tracks the laundered sum.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops — every store counts: vehicles, weapons, clothes, garages and services. A normal platinum run passes this without trying once Stage 4's property and garage purchases land. If you are short at the end, high-end car upgrades are the fastest legitimate way to burn the remainder.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties across Leonida. Garages appear for sale as the story opens new districts; each purchase is permanent and also gives you storage the vehicle trophies quietly rely on. Save this for Stage 4, when robbery income makes the full set affordable in one sweep.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide & roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app on your phone. Any vehicle you own or are driving can be registered from the app — do it as you naturally cycle through cars for Whip It Good and the two counters will climb together. Ten registrations is minutes of work once the app is unlocked.
trophies.sources: PlayStation official trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide
